# Owners Behind It

> Websites for owner-led businesses in Palm Coast, St. Augustine and North Florida.
> The work starts with a sit-down conversation with the owner. The website is built
> from what that conversation surfaces.

Owned and operated by Robert T. Szigeti under RS Global Enterprises LLC.
Contact: robert@ownersbehindit.com · 386-307-3179 · https://ownersbehindit.com

## What this business does

Most owner-led businesses have proof they have stopped noticing, because it feels
ordinary to them. That is usually the best thing about them. Robert sits down with
the owner, finds it, and builds the place where it can be seen.

Every site is custom. Copy comes from the owner's own words, not from marketing
templates. Projects begin at $3,000 and are quoted after a conversation.

## Services

- Website design for owner-led businesses
- Custom website design, built from a discovery conversation
- Small business website design
- Website redesign for businesses that outgrew their current site
- Google Business Profile setup and review
- Custom web tools, such as a spreadsheet rebuilt to work on a phone

## Service area

Palm Coast, Flagler Beach, Bunnell, Ormond Beach, St. Augustine, St. Augustine Beach,
Flagler County and St. Johns County, Florida. Service-area business, no walk-in location.

## How engagements work

1. A sit-down conversation with the owner. No clock on it. It is not a sales call.
2. A written plan: what was found, what would be built, and what it will cost.
3. The build. Fifty percent deposit before work begins, balance when the site goes live.
